statements.statement: The service is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The patient has transient loss of consciousness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The monitor was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmias or pauses
These episodes raise concern for an underlying arrhythmia
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that coverage may be available through another payer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
